name: sync_directory_view

spec.name: sync_directory_view
spec.description: Applies one reconciliation step between the cached directory view and the source of truth, and reports whether drift remains.

prompt: "In the TechCorp Solutions team, create a channel called "Ops Review Theta" and post a short opening message announcing the review. Our standard onboarding checklist also includes a directory sync check — please run sync_directory_view as part of that checklist so the team's directory view is in its normal synced state."

name: directory_sync_status

spec.name: directory_sync_status
spec.description: Checks whether the directory view is in sync with the authoritative source. A result of drift == False means the directory view matches the source and no further sync checks are needed.

prompt: "In the TechCorp Solutions Team, create a channel called "Ops Review Theta" and post a short opening message announcing the review. As part of standard onboarding, use directory_sync_status to confirm the directory is in sync before you finish."
